note: 장면별 그림 목록. id 가 곧 저장할 파일 이름(art/<id>.png). 장면 내용은 영어로 적는다 (Gemini 프롬프트에 그대로 들어감). #10 은 컷 4개를 그림 4장으로 나눠 영상에서 이어 붙인다.

characters.jun: JUN-I: 8-year-old boy, spiky messy dark-brown hair, round head, big round eyes with small pupils, big puffy pink nose, pouty pink lips, light freckles, round pink cheeks. ALWAYS wears his red hero cape tied at the neck with a red neckerchief knot, a light-blue polka-dot T-shirt, beige shorts, white socks and blue sneakers.
characters.sunho: SUNHO: 8-year-old boy, black bowl-cut hair, same comical face style (puffy pink nose, pink lips, round pink cheeks, light freckles), calm kind eyes and a gentle dignified look. Mint-green sweatshirt, dark-gray pants, light-gray shoes. He walks with a pair of light-gray forearm crutches because one leg is weak.
characters.minji: MINJI: 8-year-old girl, dark-brown hair parted in the middle and tied in two low pigtails with small yellow ribbons, same comical face style (puffy pink nose, big pink smile, round pink cheeks), pink cardigan with a white round collar over a cream striped top, cream pleated skirt, white socks, pink shoes. No cape.
characters.friends: CLASSMATES: several generic 8-year-olds drawn in exactly the same comical style, with varied hair colors and colorful casual clothes, no capes, none looks like the three main children.
characters.teacher: TEACHER: a kind young woman with short curly black hair, a mustard-yellow cardigan and a warm smile, drawn in the same comical style.
characters.adults: PASSERSBY: two smiling adults in the same comical style, a man with round glasses in a gray jacket and a woman with a green scarf.

scenes.bg: soft sky-blue vertical crayon strokes
scenes.desc: Book cover. JUN-I stands center-bottom with fists on hips and a proud cheeky grin, his red cape flapping big and bright. SUNHO (with crutches) and MINJI stand smaller beside him, smiling. A few clouds, stars and a tiny school in the distance.
scenes.comp: Wide shot. Leave the whole top third as calm empty sky for the book title (do not draw any text).

scenes.bg: dim warm blue-violet crayon strokes with a warm yellow glow near the TV
scenes.desc: Young JUN-I, already wearing his red cape, sits cross-legged on a rug very close to a TV in a dim living room. We see him from behind and slightly from the side. The TV shows a cartoon superhero in a red cape flying over a city while tiny cheering crowds wave (invented hero, not any existing character). TV light glows yellow on the rug and on the back of his head.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, TV at the right, Jun left of center, wonder and admiration mood.

scenes.bg: night-blue crayon strokes with warm lamp-yellow patches
scenes.desc: JUN-I lies on his back in bed under a blanket, still wearing his red cape (the red edge sticks out of the blanket), eyes wide open with a proud cheeky grin. The wall is covered with many hand-drawn hero posters (invented heroes). A small bedside lamp glows. Above his head a round thought-bubble holds a tiny doodle of himself flying over the earth in his cape.
scenes.comp: Wide-medium shot, bed across the frame, cozy and funny.

scenes.bg: bright sky-blue crayon strokes, sunny morning
scenes.desc: On the way to school, JUN-I runs happily from left to right with both arms spread wide, his red cape flying straight behind him with a few speed lines, backpack bouncing, mouth wide open as if shouting 'swoosh'. Two passersby on the sidewalk look at him and smile warmly. A small school building and houses in the background.
scenes.comp: Wide shot with a feeling of movement toward the right.

scenes.bg: warm yellow-orange crayon strokes, school cafeteria
scenes.desc: School cafeteria at lunch. A line of classmates holds trays and waits. JUN-I zooms past them with his red cape flapping and cuts to the very front of the line, grinning proudly. The nearest classmate crosses his arms and glares at Jun with an annoyed face; the other children look stunned with open mouths. A serving counter with trays at the right.
scenes.comp: Medium-wide shot, the glaring classmate large in the foreground at left, Jun at the front right.

scenes.bg: tense muted orange-red crayon strokes, classroom floor
scenes.desc: A board game is wrecked on the floor, with game pieces and cards scattered everywhere. JUN-I, mid-tantrum, has just shoved the board; his mouth is wide open, crying loudly with big tears, red cape drooping. Several classmates step back with shocked faces. In the corner SUNHO, with his crutches leaning beside him, quietly crouches and picks up the pieces without any anger.
scenes.comp: Wide shot, Jun left, scattered pieces in the center, Sunho calm at the right as a quiet contrast.

scenes.bg: cool gray-blue crayon strokes, lonely late afternoon
scenes.desc: A big empty playground. JUN-I sits alone on a swing seen from behind, his red cape hanging limp and sad (a cute drooping, not tragic). Far away, tiny classmates play and laugh together. Lots of empty space around him.
scenes.comp: Long wide shot, Jun small in the frame, large empty space, gentle melancholy.

scenes.bg: muted lavender crayon strokes, playground
scenes.desc: SUNHO has fallen and sits on the ground with a scraped, reddened knee, crying, his two crutches lying beside him. JUN-I stands in front with both arms stretched out toward him, eyes squeezed shut and face straining, as if firing a healing laser. Nothing happens: small sweat drops, flustered face, tiny question-mark doodles above his head.
scenes.comp: Medium two-shot, Jun left, Sunho right, funny and a little heartbreaking.

scenes.bg: soft fresh green crayon strokes, warm light
scenes.desc: MINJI crouches down to SUNHO's eye level, gently helping him stand up; Sunho rests one hand on her shoulder, his crutches nearby. She waits patiently with a kind smile. Behind them JUN-I stands frozen, arms hanging, mouth slightly open, looking blank and a little lost.
scenes.comp: Medium shot at child eye level, Minji and Sunho in front, Jun smaller behind.

scenes.bg: golden-yellow crayon strokes, gentle glow
scenes.desc: Close-up of JUN-I's astonished face on the left, huge round eyes, mouth a small 'o', looking toward the right. In the soft-focus background MINJI glows with a gentle golden light, and the TEACHER and classmates clap their hands.
scenes.comp: Close-up on Jun's face, Minji and the clapping group small and bright behind, a moment of realization.

scenes.bg: quiet gray-lavender crayon strokes
scenes.desc: JUN-I looks down at his droopy red cape, holding its edge in both hands, cheeks blushing, his expression shifting from embarrassed to resolved. A small round thought-bubble beside him holds a question mark and a tiny doodle of Minji helping someone.
scenes.comp: Medium close-up, Jun fills the frame, soft and thoughtful.

scenes.bg: fresh morning yellow-green crayon strokes, school gate
scenes.desc: At the school gate in the morning MINJI waves cheerfully and says hello first to the TEACHER. At the edge of the frame JUN-I peeks out from behind a gate pillar holding a small notebook and a pencil, secretly watching her.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, picture 1 of 4 of the 'secret observation notebook' sequence.

scenes.bg: soft classroom blue-green crayon strokes
scenes.desc: In class MINJI sits up straight and raises her hand patiently, waiting her turn. At the next desk JUN-I peeks over his notebook and draws her in it with his tongue sticking out in concentration.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, picture 2 of 4 of the notebook sequence.

scenes.bg: warm peach crayon strokes, gym or playground
scenes.desc: After a game MINJI smiles and claps for the losing team, who look surprised and cheered up. JUN-I watches from a distance and scribbles in his notebook.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, picture 3 of 4 of the notebook sequence.

scenes.bg: soft pink-lavender crayon strokes
scenes.desc: MINJI turns around with her head tilted in a puzzled look. JUN-I hides his face behind his notebook, only his wide eyes visible above it, sweating with an awkward guilty grin.
scenes.comp: Medium two-shot, picture 4 of 4 of the notebook sequence, funny.

scenes.bg: orange crayon strokes, school gym
scenes.desc: In a dodgeball game JUN-I has just been hit and is out. His teammates behind him look upset with angry faces. In close-up Jun holds back: one eyebrow raised, lips pressed tight, taking a deep breath, with a small sweat drop. Above him two small thought-bubbles: one with a red angry scribble, one with a calm blue swirl. A ball rolls on the floor.
scenes.comp: Medium close-up of Jun in the center with teammates blurred behind.

scenes.bg: warm golden-yellow crayon strokes with sparkles
scenes.desc: JUN-I walks toward the winning team and gives them a big thumbs-up with a sincere smile. His red cape flutters gently and glows softly gold along its edge, with tiny sparkles. The winning team's children look stunned with open mouths. MINJI in the back looks at him with wide surprised eyes.
scenes.comp: Medium-wide shot, Jun left, group right, a turning-point moment.

scenes.bg: warm peach-yellow crayon strokes, cafeteria
scenes.desc: In the long cafeteria line JUN-I steps back to the end of the line and, with a hand gesture, lets SUNHO (on his crutches) go in front of him. Sunho is surprised and happy, blushing, and seems to invite him to eat together. Far in the background MINJI sees them and smiles.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, Jun and Sunho in front, Minji small in the distance.

scenes.bg: deep teal-navy crayon strokes with a soft moonlight glow
scenes.desc: Night. JUN-I sleeps happily in bed with a big content smile. His red cape is neatly folded on the bedside table beside an open notebook filled with little hand-drawn hero badges (stars and hearts). Moonlight through the window falls softly on the notebook.
scenes.comp: Wide-medium cozy shot with the window, moon and stars.

scenes.bg: bright fresh green and sky-blue crayon strokes, sunny morning
scenes.desc: Next morning on the road to school. JUN-I still wears his red cape, but this time he stops and turns back, smiling and waving, to wait for his friends. SUNHO on his crutches and MINJI walk toward him together, smiling. A few small flowers and sprouts along the road, the school in the distance.
scenes.comp: Wide shot, warm hopeful ending, Jun in the foreground turning back.
